Name: grid_width
Parameter description: "The spatial extent of the map in the x/east direction

Name: grid_height
column4: "The spatial extent of the map in the y/north direction

Name: grid_llx
column4: "The ENU coordinate of the lower-left corner of the grid in the x/east direction

Name: grid_lly
column4: "The ENU coordinate of the lower-left corner of the grid in the y/north direction

Name: warmup_time
Parameter description: "The amount of time in seconds for which the perception node will idle after startup. This gives time for the sensors and other algorithms to come online."

Name: time_register_window
Parameter description: "The maximum amount of time in seconds for which an odometry message can be synchronized with a point cloud message for point cloud registration. If  point cloud message does not have a matching odometry message within plus or minus *time_register_window* seconds

Name: thresh
Parameter description: "The height / slope threshhold used to determine if a cell is an obstacle."

Name: use_elevation
column4: the absolute value of the elevation range in a cell will be compared to the value of 'thresh' to determine if the cell is occupied. If false
column5: the cell slope ((highest-lowest)/resolution) will be compared to thresh."

Name: use_registered
column4: the algorithm will assume the incoming point cloud is already registered to world coordinates. If false
column5: the point cloud will be registered using the recieved odometry."

Name: overhead_clearance
Parameter description: "Ignore points this distance above the vehicles current position (meters)."

Name: stitch_lidar_points
column4: successive lidar scans will be stitched together (registered) using the vehicle location. If false
column5: individual scans will be used without stitching
column6: meaning the map will not be built up over time."

Name: filter_highest_lidar
column4: "The perception module calculates slope using the highest and lowest points within a cell. If this is set to 'true'
column5: the slope will be calculated using the 2nd highest and the lowest
column6: and the highest point will be ignored. Default is false. Setting to true will filter out some of the false lidar returns in noisy data."
